description: This source file defines a Java class `GenerateUuid` that implements a Liquibase custom task for generating and assigning UUIDs to rows in specified database tables. It includes logic for handling different database types (MySQL/MariaDB versus others), parameter parsing, and batch updates.

classes.name: GenerateUuid
classes.description: A Java class implementing Liquibase's CustomTaskChange to generate UUIDs for database table rows, with logic for batch processing and database-specific UUID generation.
